info.title: Forge.Cli
info.description: Laravel-Artisan-style architectural code generator for ASP.NET Core.

options.name: --help
options.description: Show help and usage information

options.name: --version
options.description: Show version information

commands.name: make:solution
commands.description: Scaffold a full onion-architecture solution, wired and ready to build.

options.name: --name
options.description: Solution name (e.g. OfficeCommute).

options.name: --output
options.description: Directory to scaffold into. Defaults to ./<name>.

options.name: --template
options.description: Template id. Defaults to onion-wolverine-erroror.

options.name: --role-guard
options.description: single-array (default) or role-and-subrole.

options.name: --scheduler
options.description: wolverine (default), hangfire or quartz.

options.name: --framework
options.description: Target framework for generated projects. Defaults to net10.0 (the runtime forge is running on, so the result is guaranteed runnable).

options.name: --pin-forge
options.description: Also write .config/dotnet-tools.json pinning this forge version. Only use when this version is restorable from a configured feed. [default: False]

options.name: --with-runtime
options.description: Reference Pitechy.Forge.Runtime and wire the hook into Program.cs, enabling db:seed and invoke:* (Tier 2). [default: False]

options.name: --with-base-entity
options.description: Generate a BaseEntity carrying Id and audit timestamps, and derive every generated entity from it. [default: False]

options.name: --force
options.description: Overwrite existing files instead of refusing. [default: False]

options.name: --overwrite-modified
options.description: With --force, also overwrite files edited since forge generated them. Without this, --force only replaces untouched output. [default: False]

options.name: --dry-run
options.description: Show the diff of what would change; write nothing. [default: False]

options.name: --json
options.description: Emit machine-readable JSON instead of the human summary. [default: False]

options.name: --no-color
options.description: Suppress ANSI colour (NO_COLOR is also honoured). [default: False]

options.name: --verbosity
options.description: Output detail: q[uiet], m[inimal], d[etailed].

commands.name: make:entity
commands.description: Scaffold a Domain entity plus its EF Core IEntityTypeConfiguration.

options.name: --name
options.description: Entity name (e.g. Product).

options.name: --properties
options.description: Comma-separated Name:type list, e.g. "Name:string,Price:decimal,Notes:string?".

options.name: --skip-dbset
options.description: Do not add a DbSet property to the DbContext. [default: False]

options.name: --public-setters
options.description: Emit { get; set; } instead of the default encapsulated entity (private setters + constructor + Update). [default: False]

options.name: --belongs-to
options.description: Entities this one references, e.g. --belongs-to Author "Publisher?". Each adds a {Target}Id foreign key and a navigation property; a trailing ? makes the relationship optional.

commands.description: Scaffold a command/query record, its Wolverine handler and a validator.

options.name: --name
options.description: Feature name (e.g. CreateGig).

options.name: --roles
options.description: Roles allowed to execute this message, e.g. --roles User Admin.

options.name: --anonymous

options.name: --group

options.name: --returns

options.name: --properties
